positive_snippets: My stay was truly enjoyable. The room was exactly as pictured on the website, and all of my expectations were exceeded. It felt like a luxurious retreat, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in town!
negative_snippets: Terrible experience at Nidra Hotel in Dwarka! Not only did I find a hidden camera in the room, but the hotel also overcharged us. To make matters worse, another guest entered our room with the same key due to a mistake by the receptionist. And if that wasn't enough, the room was in a deplorable state - dusty bed, insects crawling around, cracks on the wall... it felt like the room hadn't been cleaned in days. The lack of security, privacy, and basic cleanliness is appalling. I'm warning others to avoid this hotel at all costs. Look elsewhere for a safe, clean, and respectful place to stay.

Stayed there for 3 days and 2 nights. Small cockroaches on bed. No cleaning beneath the bed. Dusty. No natural lighting or ventilation. Very average food. But they allow you to order from delivery apps.

Better skipped if you're a family. If you're a bunch of dudes that need a place to crash after party, then worth it.

What’s the point of taking feedback when you don’t act on it ?
I saw some older reviews on cockroaches and I thought since owner replied on those then that problem is resolved.
But this was not the case.
How difficult is this to keep the rooms clean ? And remove cockroaches dead and alive.
